We need DBE for C9H10O4. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). No N. So DBE = 9 - 10/2 + 1 = 9 -5 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already have. Might verify using tool retrieve_dbe_formula? It likely returns formula. Could call to be safe.
